payload.content: Planning coordination from Jenise: I have 6 hours available and strong skills in machine-learning (0.79). I see tasks related to mobile-development and machine-learning (ISSUE-0002) with low priority. My costs for implementing, reviewing, or testing those tasks are high, but reviewing (cost=6.09) and testing (cost=8.52) are more feasible than implementing (cost=12.17). I will coordinate to avoid overlap with others on ISSUE-0002 review and test tasks and avoid the frontend tasks due to high cost and lack of skill match. I am open to suggestions from others on their intended tasks to optimize overall task allocation.
